    Profile

    Hisham is a man who grew up in a particularly dry and arid desert region. He travels alone, using his ability to find underground water sources to bring water to different desert regions. He has a habit of staying silent—a reflex learned in order to prevent his mouth from drying out—but in fact has great communication skills and lots of things to talk about.

    Origin: Desert Zone
    Gender: Male
    Height: 169cm
    Weight: 77kg
    Birthday: Jan 8
    Blood Type: Type Pa
    Zodiac: Moon of the Bright Knight
    Likes: Water, meat pie
    Hobbies: Reading, cooking
    Illust: 大盛よしを
    CV: 森田則昭
